THE BUILD

The thinking behind the page.

A useful project has to connect its interface to the visitor’s task.

Audience

People who need a clear path into Jabalpur Connect and an interface they can understand quickly.

Experience

Bringing discovery, messaging, and account management into a mobile-friendly experience.

Next iteration

Review real visitor feedback and refine the areas where people hesitate or need more context.

Interface decisions

A local community product needs more than a profile card. Discovery, preferences, mutual interest, chat and account controls have to form a coherent path.

What I would keep refining

For a social experience, clear reporting and blocking routes are part of the interface. I also consider how visitors understand what is public on a profile and what stays inside a conversation.
